topography.project_purpose: Wing Finance is a decentralized lending protocol that allows users to supply and borrow crypto assets across multiple chains. It also includes governance and token distribution mechanisms.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Wing Token family provides the governance token used by the Governance Accounts family to manage protocol parameters and treasury. The Wing Finance lending market relies on the governance system for upgrades and parameter changes, and may distribute WING tokens as incentives.
